data.short_meaning: God of Ram, Lord of Strength
data.long_meaning: Ramkishun is derived from the name Ram, which is the name of the seventh avatar of Lord Vishnu, and kishun meaning lord of strength. This name is given to a baby boy to bless him with the strength, power, and victory in life. The name Ramkishun carries the meaning “God of Ram, Lord of Strength” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Ramkishun usually hope their child will grow to embody god of ram, lord of strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ramkishun is a divine name, representing the embodiment of Lord Ram's strength and power. It is believed that this name can help the bearer overcome any obstacles in life and achieve success.
data.etymology: Ramkishun belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Ram, Lord of Strength.”
